personal_info.summary: Problem solver with a scientific mindset. Using my biology background and +3 years of software development skills to create effective solutions. Proficient in JavaScript, React.js, Next.js, HTML and CSS. Experience in leading projects and mentoring teams.

responsibilities: Develop FrontEnd solutions using React, Next.js, and CMS technologies for diverse clients.
Managed project lifecycles using agile methodologies to ensure efficient and high-quality deliverables.
Collaborated with clients to create tailored solutions that enhanced their digital presence and user experience.

Intensive two-month training focused on FrontEnd technologies, covering HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular, accessibility, and an introduction to backend technologies such as AWS, Node.js, and MongoDB.
Contributed to a Subscription Management project, building a full-stack CRUD application with React, CSS Modules, Node.js, MongoDB, and middleware.
Mentorship phase, shadowing a senior developer and deepening my knowledge of Angular.
Empowering women by teaching essential FrontEnd development skills at Ada, a non-governmental organization.
Leading comprehensive lessons on HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React, and Responsive Design to help students build a strong foundation in web development.
Worked on redesigning pages using React and Next.js to enhance user experience.
Implemented 301 and 302 redirects to improve site SEO and avoid redirect chains.
Built dynamic templates managed with GraphQL to streamline content management in the CMS.
Helped resolve critical PayPal API issues, managing the MySQL database to ensure accurate payments for over 2,000 transactions and 500 users.
Collaborated with a multicultural team, working across different time zones.
Gained experience with backend technologies, working with databases and SQL scripts to support my frontend tasks.
